verdict.rationale: Meilisearch's own docs say it exposes stored documents and embeddings through semantic search and "conversational interfaces, all from a single API." Its product pages position it as a RAG retrieval layer and offer conversational answers grounded in your content, backed by documented hybrid/semantic search with automatic embeddings. However, the evidence shows no documented answer or chat endpoint, and no detail on request/response shape or grounding and citation behavior, so the conversational-answer half rests mainly on marketing pages. Missing for 10: documented conversational/answer API endpoint details, RAG integration docs (LLM configuration, prompts, source citations), independent hands-on corroboration of conversational answers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can power RAG and conversational answers on top of my indexes with documented retrieval or answer APIs

citations.quote: It stores your documents and embeddings, then exposes them through fast full-text search, semantic search, and conversational interfaces, all from a single API.
Let users ask questions and get real answers, grounded in your own content.
The retrieval layer your AI applications need. Give your models accurate, current context from your own data.
When you configure an embedder, Meilisearch automatically generates vector embeddings for every document in your index.
